emails.subject: Trade-in question about the VW Golf
emails.body: Hi, I saw a Volkswagen Golf 1.5 TSI Comfortline on your website. I have interest and would like to trade in my Opel Astra from 2018, it has 125,000 km on the clock. The license plate is X-123-AB, petrol, manual gearbox. Looking forward to hearing what you can offer me. Best regards, Jan Dijkstra

emails.subject: Toyota Corolla + trade-in
emails.body: Hello, is the Toyota Corolla 1.8 Hybrid still available? I would like to trade in my Ford Focus from 2019 with 95,000 km, petrol, manual. License plate KL-567-CD. Kind regards, Sanne Peeters

emails.subject: Peugeot 208 interest
emails.body: Hi there, I am interested in the Peugeot 208 1.2 PureTech you have listed. My own car is a Renault Clio from 2020, petrol, manual, with 60,000 km. Could you tell me what my car is worth as a trade-in? Regards, Mark Bakker

emails.subject: Volvo V60 trade-in
emails.body: Dear sir/madam, I would like to buy the Volvo V60 B4 you have in stock. For trade-in I offer my BMW 3 Series from 2017, automatic, petrol, with about 140,000 km. The plate is GH-234-JK. Thank you, Linda Jansen

emails.subject: Do you have a Golf GTI?
emails.body: Hi, I am looking for a Volkswagen Golf GTI. Do you have one? If so I would trade in my Opel Astra from 2019 with 90,000 km, petrol, manual, plate MN-789-EF. Greetings, Peter Willems

emails.subject: Tesla Model 3 question
emails.body: Hello, do you have a Tesla Model 3 in stock? I would like to move away from petrol. My trade-in is a Volkswagen Golf from 2020, petrol, manual, 70,000 km, license plate RS-345-GH. Best regards, Anne de Vries

emails.subject: Audi A4 still available?
emails.body: Hi, I saw an Audi A4 40 TDI on your site. Is it still for sale? I want to trade in my Hyundai i30 from 2019, automatic, petrol, with 110,000 km. Plate TB-901-KL. Kind regards, Rob Smit

emails.subject: Trade-in Kia Niro
emails.body: Hello, I am interested in the Kia Niro you have listed. I would like to trade in my Opel Corsa from 2019, petrol, manual. Can you tell me what it is worth? Regards, Kim Mulder

emails.subject: Ford Puma question
emails.body: Hi, is the Ford Puma still available? For trade-in I have a Skoda Octavia, petrol, manual, with 130,000 km on it. Cheers, Tom Hoogland

emails.subject: Trade-in Opel Corsa
emails.body: Hi, I saw the Opel Corsa 1.2 Elegance on your website and I love it. My current car has license plate FR-111-ZZ. What can you offer me for it? Best, Emma Visser

emails.subject: Skoda Octavia interest
emails.body: Hello, I am interested in the Skoda Octavia you have for sale. I would also like to trade in my current car. Could you let me know the possibilities? Kind regards, Dirk Kuiper

emails.subject: Trade-in value?
emails.body: Hi, I would like to buy the Hyundai Kona. My trade-in is a Skoda Octavia from 2018, petrol, manual, with 110,000 km. The license plate is ZZ-999-ZZ. What is it worth? Regards, Femke Groot

emails.subject: Classic trade-in
emails.body: Hello, I am interested in the Mercedes C-Class you have listed. I own a classic Volkswagen Beetle from 1985, petrol, manual, with 310,000 km, plate PV-456-XY. What would you give me for it? Best regards, Hans Boer

emails.subject: Van trade-in
emails.body: Hi, I would like to buy the Renault Megane E-Tech. For trade-in I have my Mercedes-Benz Sprinter van from 2016, diesel, manual, with 240,000 km. License plate BK-222-WW. Greetings, Bram Zwart

emails.subject: Question about your stock
emails.body: Hello, do you still have the Toyota Corolla available? I would like to trade in my own car, a Polo with plate SK-778-OP. Kind regards, Nienke Elzinga
